# Proposal: Customer support assistant for Bluefin Logistics

Prepared by Northwind Labs d.o.o. for Bluefin Logistics GmbH (fictional companies, test data only).

## Summary

Northwind Labs will build and launch a customer support assistant on the Bluefin website. Total price: EUR 24,000 excluding VAT. Go-live on 15 March 2027.

## Scope

- Assistant trained on the Bluefin help center and shipping FAQ.
- Handover to a human agent in the existing ticketing tool.
- Two languages: German and English.

Not included: phone support, changes to the ticketing tool itself.

## Timeline

- Kick-off: 12 January 2027
- Bluefin provides help center export and ticketing API access
- Testing with the Bluefin support team: from 1 March 2027
- Go-live: 15 March 2027

## Results

The assistant will resolve 70% of incoming support questions without a human from the first month.
